Step 7 (Tech View) and Step 9 (Board View): "Imported" is greyed out in Status, cannot be ticked, and hovering it shows "Imported work orders open in List."

impacted_cases.title: The clear-shifts question appears only for the old lead's unfinished shifts
impacted_cases.change: CH-5 (PRD v47, 12 Oct): S4-R28 defines a work-order-level shift as one that covers every current line
impacted_cases.what_tester_sees_differently: Work order C has a single line, "Line 1". A shift that covers its only line covers every current line, so under v47 it is a work-order-level shift and the clear-shifts question must open for C. The case expects no question for C, so a tester fails a correct build. The setup also cannot be followed as written: on a one-line work order the Schedule books the drop at once, without the Entire work order / Choose lines window (C368178 records this).
impacted_cases.expected_before:
Only A opens the "Clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts?" prompt (1 of 6).
B (no shift), C (only a line shift), D (only an ended shift), E (only Dana Ortiz's shift) and F (Esther Howard's shift is on another work order) change lead straight away with "Lead technician updated" and no prompt (5 of 6).
impacted_cases.expected_now: Only A opens the "Clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts?" question; C must be a work order with at least two lines and Esther Howard's shift on only one of them, and then C changes lead with no question. (Whether a shift on the only line of a one-line work order shows the question: yes, by the v47 definition — see PO question PQ-1.)
impacted_cases.source: PRD 845185030 v47 (2026-10-12 13:11 UTC, Chris Ward), S4-R28 — https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=845185030&selectedPageVersions=46&selectedPageVersions=47 · Jira SV-11126 (Done 13 Oct)
quotes: S4-R28: “The shift-clearing prompt (S4-R11, S4-R26) shows only when the outgoing lead has a work-order-level shift on this work order that has not ended. A work-order-level shift is one that covers every current line of the work order, which is what the Schedule’s Entire work order drop creates. A shift on only some lines does not show the prompt.”
impacted_cases.note: Automated in TestRail (tell the automation owner). Its "What you should see today" note (no question ever shows) is out of date since build e84b3d1 (12 Oct, SV-11126 fixed), so outcome (3) applies.

impacted_cases.title: Clear shifts removes only the old lead's whole-work-order shifts
impacted_cases.change: CH-5 (PRD v47, 12 Oct): S4-R28 defines a work-order-level shift as one that covers every current line
impacted_cases.what_tester_sees_differently: [WO-1] and [WO-2] each have one line, "Line 1". Esther Howard's 13:00–15:00 "Line 1" shift covers every current line, so under v47 it is a work-order-level shift: Clear shifts on [WO-1] removes it too. The case expects it to survive ("the prompt never clears line shifts"), so a tester fails a correct build. The "Choose lines" setup step also cannot be done on a one-line work order (the Schedule books it at once).
impacted_cases.expected_before:
Both drags open a prompt asking whether to clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts for the whole work order.
After Clear shifts: "S1-702" is led by Ralph Edwards, Esther Howard's 8:00–12:00 whole-work-order shift on it is gone, Dana Ortiz's 8:00–10:00 shift on it is still there, and Esther Howard's shift on "S1-691" is untouched.
After Keep shifts: "S1-698" is led by Ralph Edwards and both Esther Howard shifts on it are still there.
Esther Howard's 13:00–15:00 Line 1 shifts are still there on both work orders: the prompt never clears line shifts.
impacted_cases.expected_now: Same results, with [WO-1] and [WO-2] given at least two lines and the 13:00–15:00 shift on Line 1 only: after Clear shifts the 8:00–12:00 whole-work-order shift is gone and the Line 1 shift stays.
quotes: S4-R28: “… A work-order-level shift is one that covers every current line of the work order, which is what the Schedule’s Entire work order drop creates. A shift on only some lines does not show the prompt.”
S4-R24: “Never clear shifts scheduled against individual work order lines through this prompt.”
impacted_cases.note: Vladimir Tomovic edited this case on 12 Oct 13:32 UTC: he added the v47 S4-R28 quote but left the one-line work orders, so the conflict remains.

impacted_cases.title: Owner drags a work order to another technician on Board View and clears the outgoing lead shifts
impacted_cases.change: CH-5 (PRD v47, 12 Oct): S4-R28 defines a work-order-level shift as one that covers every current line
impacted_cases.what_tester_sees_differently: The work order has "one line authorized for repair" and a "line-level shift for A on the authorized line". If that is the only line, the shift covers every current line, so it is work-order-level under v47 and Clear shifts removes it; step 5 expects it to stay. Likely to fail a correct build (depends on whether the work order has other, unauthorized lines — PO question PQ-1).
impacted_cases.expected_before: Step 5: Read A's shifts back. → The whole-work-order shift is gone; the line-level shift still exists, unchanged.
impacted_cases.expected_now: Give the work order two lines and put the line-level shift on one of them; then step 5 holds as written.
quotes: S4-R28: “A work-order-level shift is one that covers every current line of the work order … A shift on only some lines does not show the prompt.”
impacted_cases.note: Created by Vladimir Tomovic and automated: hands-off for us (Rule 38); for its owner.

new_tests.title: With a filter on and no match, Tech View and Board View show the List's filtered empty state
new_tests.why: S1-N1 reworded and S1-N1a added (v43, 8 Oct 22:11 UTC); the only case for it (C96918) was deleted by 12 Oct
new_tests.source: PRD v43 S1-N1, S1-N1a — https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=845185030&selectedPageVersions=42&selectedPageVersions=43 · Chris Ward, #fs-board-tech-view, 8 Oct 22:12 UTC https://shopview.slack.com/archives/C0C41RV3T3L/p1791497536300869
new_tests.before_you_start: A location with some work orders; desktop window 1024 px or wider.
steps: Tick a Status that no work order at this location has (or combine filters until nothing matches).

po_questions.question: (a) Does a shift on the only line of a one-line work order count as a work-order-level shift, so the question opens? (b) Does a "Choose lines" shift that ticks every line count? (c) Do unapproved or declined lines count as "current lines"? (d) If a line is added after an Entire work order shift was made, is that shift still work-order-level?
po_questions.what_we_know: v47 says "covers every current line … which is what the Schedule's Entire work order drop creates"; Slavcho (SV-11126, 12 Oct) describes it as "a shift created with the Schedule's Entire work order option"; on a one-line work order the Schedule books the drop at once with no choice. Four cases depend on the answer (C368133, C96965, C236975, C236976).
